**Average winter daytime temperature in Richmond, Virginia (the state where the Battle of Fredericksburg was fought)**  

| Month | Mean Daily High (°F) | Mean Daily High (°C) |
|-------|---------------------|----------------------|
| December | 51 °F | 11.1 °C |
| January | 47 °F | 8.9 °C |
| February | 51 °F | 11.1 °C |

**Overall winter average (Dec–Feb)**  
• **≈ 49.7 °F** (≈ 9.2 °C).

These figures come from the 1991‑2020 climate normals for *Richmond, Virginia* (US Climate Data/NOAA). They reflect the typical daytime highs during the coldest months of the year.
